flashcard_questions.q: The techniques and conventions used in media products to convey meaning, create impact, and engage audiences, divided into technical, symbolic, and written codes.
The different framings used by a camera operator to show varying amounts of the subject and surroundings, from extreme close-up to extreme long shot.
The position of the camera relative to the subject, which affects how the audience perceives the subject's power, vulnerability, or relationship to the scene.

flashcard_questions.a: The physical movement of the camera during filming, including panning, tilting, tracking, and zooming, each creating different visual effects.

flashcard_questions.q: Which camera movement rotates the camera vertically up or down on a fixed point?
